question: How many seats did the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) win in the 2025 Bihar Assembly election?
solution:
The correct answer is __**89**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **2025 Bihar Legislative Assembly election** was conducted to elect representatives for the **243 constituencies** of the state assembly.
 
• The **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)** secured a total of **89 seats**, emerging as a primary pillar of the **National Democratic Alliance (NDA)** in the state.
 
• The election results were officially declared in **November 2025**, following a multi-phase voting process that spanned across the **38 districts** of **Bihar**.
 
• The **89 seats** won by the **BJP** represented a significant portion of the **122 seats** required to reach the **majority mark** in the **Bihar Vidhan Sabha**.
 
• This election saw the **BJP** consolidate its presence in key regions such as **North Bihar** and the **Magadh** division, contributing to the overall stability of the coalition government.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Bihar Legislative Assembly (Vidhan Sabha):**
 
 
• The **Bihar Legislative Assembly** consists of **243 elected members**, each serving a term of **5 years**.
 
• It is the lower house of the **Bicameral Legislature** of **Bihar**, with the **Legislative Council (Vidhan Parishad)** being the upper house.
 
• The **2025** election was the **18th** assembly election held in the state since **Independence**.
 
 
 
• **Alliance Dynamics:**
 
 
• The **BJP** contested the **2025** elections in alliance with the **Janata Dal (United)**, led by **Nitish Kumar**, under the banner of the **National Democratic Alliance (NDA)**.
 
• The primary opposition was the **Mahagathbandhan** (Grand Alliance), which included the **Rashtriya Janata Dal (RJD)** and the **Indian National Congress**.
 
• Key state leaders for the **BJP** during this period included **Samrat Choudhary** and **Vijay Kumar Sinha**.
 
 
 
• **Comparison and Trends:**
 
 
• In the previous **2020 Bihar Assembly elections**, the **BJP** had won **74 seats**; thus, the **89 seats** in **2025** indicate an upward trajectory in their electoral performance.
 
• The election was managed by the **Election Commission of India (ECI)**, utilizing **Voter Verifiable Paper Audit Trail (VVPAT)** and **Electronic Voting Machines (EVM)** across all booths.
 
• Major campaign themes included **economic development**, **social justice**, and **infrastructure projects** under the **Double Engine Government** narrative.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Constitutional Framework:** The conduct of state elections is governed by **Article 324** of the **Constitution of India**, which grants the **Election Commission** the power of superintendence, direction, and control.
 
• **Seat Distribution:** Out of the **243 seats** in **Bihar**, **38 seats** are reserved for **Scheduled Castes (SC)** and **2 seats** are reserved for **Scheduled Tribes (ST)**.
 
• **Geopolitical Impact:** The **BJP's** performance in **Bihar** is often seen as a bellwether for political trends in the **Hindi Heartland** and has significant implications for the **Rajya Sabha** seat distribution.
